info.name: Payroll Module
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Payroll Module covering Payrolls, Payroll Adjustments, and Payslips.

**Base URL:** `{{base_url}}/api/companies/{{company_id}}`

**Auth:** All routes require a Bearer token via the `Authorization` header.

**Roles:**
- `isAdmin` — full access
- `isManager` — read + limited write
- `isEmployee` — self-service read only

item.name: Payrolls
item.description: Core payroll records — one per employee per payroll period. Handles generation, retrieval, status transitions, and deletion.

request.description:
**Role:** `isAdmin`

Triggers full payroll computation for all active employees in the company (or a specific branch if `branch_id` is provided).

For each employee the engine:
1. Fetches their salary structure effective on the period start date
2. Classifies every calendar day (present, absent, holiday, week-off, paid leave, unpaid leave)
3. Applies the sandwich-leave rule
4. Calculates deductions, overtime, and net salary

Skips employees who already have a payroll record for the period.

request.description:
**Role:** `isManager`

Returns all payroll records belonging to the company across all periods.

**Role:** `isManager`

Fetches a single payroll record by its UUID.

**Role:** `isManager`

Returns all payroll records for a specific payroll period. Useful for period-level reporting and bulk status updates.

**Role:** `isManager`

Returns full payroll history for a specific employee across all periods.

**Role:** `isAdmin`

Transitions the payroll to a new status. Valid transitions:
- `draft` → `processed` or `cancelled`
- `processed` → `paid` or `cancelled`
- `paid` → _(terminal, no transitions allowed)_
- `cancelled` → _(terminal, no transitions allowed)_

Setting status to `paid` also stamps the `paid_at` timestamp.

response.name: 400 Bad Request — Invalid Status

request.description:
**Role:** `isAdmin`

Permanently deletes a payroll record. Only allowed when `payroll_status` is `draft` or `cancelled`. Cascades to linked adjustments and payslips.

response.name: 400 Bad Request — Cannot Delete

item.name: Payroll Adjustments
item.description:
Line-item adjustments attached to a payroll record. Recalculates `bonus_amount`, `deduction_amount`, and `net_salary` automatically after every mutation.

**Types:** `bonus`, `deduction`, `commission`, `penalty`, `loan`

body.raw:
{
  "payroll_id": "{{payroll_id}}",
  "adjustment_type": "bonus",
  "title": "Performance Bonus Q1",
  "amount": 500.00,
  "is_taxable": false,
  "remarks": "Awarded for exceeding Q1 targets"
}

request.description:
**Role:** `isAdmin`

Adds a single adjustment to an existing payroll. The payroll must not be `paid` or `cancelled`. After creation, `bonus_amount` / `deduction_amount` and `net_salary` on the parent payroll are recalculated automatically.

request.description:
**Role:** `isAdmin`

Deletes a single adjustment. Blocked on `paid` or `cancelled` payrolls. Recalculates payroll totals automatically after removal.

**Role:** `isAdmin`

Removes all adjustments from a payroll in one call. Typically used before re-processing a payroll. Resets `bonus_amount` and `deduction_amount` to 0 and recalculates `net_salary`.

response.name: 400 Bad Request — Paid Payroll

item.name: Payslips
item.description: Payslip documents generated from processed/paid payroll records. Each payroll can have exactly one payslip. Includes a unique human-readable slip number and an optional PDF URL.

request.description:
**Role:** `isAdmin`

Generates a payslip for a single payroll record. The payroll must be in `processed` or `paid` status. Assigns a unique slip number in the format `PSL-{YYYYMM}-{EMPLOYEE_CODE}-{RANDOM4}`.

response.name: 400 Bad Request — Wrong Status
400 Bad Request — Already Exists

request.description:
**Role:** `isAdmin`

Generates payslips for all eligible payroll records in a period. Skips employees who already have a payslip or whose payroll is not `processed`/`paid`. Returns a summary of generated, skipped, and errored records.

response.name: 201 Created
400 Bad Request — No Payrolls Found

request.description:
**Role:** `isManager`

Fetches a payslip by UUID, including all associated adjustments for full document rendering.

**Role:** `isManager`

Looks up the payslip linked to a specific payroll record, including adjustments.

response.name: 404 Not Found

request.description:
**Role:** `isEmployee`

Looks up a payslip by its human-readable slip number (e.g. from a printed slip QR code scan). Includes adjustments.

**Role:** `isEmployee`

Returns the full payslip history for an employee. Employees can use this to view their own past slips.

**Role:** `isManager`

Returns all payslips generated for a specific payroll period. Useful for period-level audits.

**Role:** `isAdmin`

Attaches or updates the PDF document URL on a payslip. Called after the PDF is generated asynchronously by a background job or on-demand renderer.

**Role:** `isAdmin`

Deletes a payslip record (e.g. to regenerate after corrections). Blocked if the linked payroll is already `paid`.

response.name: 400 Bad Request — Linked to Paid Payroll
